supported_scope: Native integration with external tools via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and permission-controlled execution of commands and tools.
unestablished_scope: Native integration support without connecting a service
Limits on connections or usage quotas
required_setup: Configure MCP servers in mcpServers with appropriate authentication (OAuth or Google credentials), set permissions for MCP tools and commands, and optionally adjust toolPermission and sandbox settings.
constraints: Access to MCP tools and resources is governed by Antigravity’s permissions system requiring explicit allow rules or user approval (page: mcp, section: Model Context Protocol (MCP) > MCP permissions and access control).

OAuth authentication is handled automatically for servers supporting dynamic client registration or manually configured with client credentials (page: mcp, section: Model Context Protocol (MCP) > MCP authentication > OAuth).
Terminal sandbox restricts network and filesystem access unless permissions allow otherwise (page: sandbox, section: Terminal sandbox > Antigravity CLI > CLI permissions integration).

Commands and MCP tools require explicit permission rules in the form action(target), e.g., mcp(server/tool) or mcp(*) (page: permissions, section: Agent permissions > Antigravity CLI > Supported CLI actions and matching rules).

evidence.section: Model Context Protocol (MCP) > MCP permissions and access control
evidence.quote: Access to Model Context Protocol tools and resources is governed by Antigravity’s permissions system. By default, unconfigured MCP tools run in Ask mode, requiring your approval before execution.
evidence.claim: MCP tool access requires permissions and user approval by default.

evidence.section: Model Context Protocol (MCP) > Supported MCP servers
evidence.quote: The MCP Store features direct integrations for a wide variety of developer platforms, databases, and productivity services: Databases and storage (15 servers)... Developer tools and CI/CD (17 servers)...
evidence.claim: Antigravity supports many MCP servers for external tool integration.

evidence.section: Model Context Protocol (MCP) > MCP authentication > OAuth
evidence.quote: Antigravity automatically handles OAuth for servers that support dynamic client registration (DCR). For these servers, no additional configuration is needed...
evidence.claim: OAuth authentication for MCP servers is supported and can be automatic or manual.

evidence.section: Terminal sandbox > Antigravity CLI > CLI permissions integration
evidence.quote: The sandbox derives its access boundaries from your Permissions configuration: Filesystem: Workspace folders and paths allowed under write_file are mounted read-write... Network: Sandboxed commands run without network access by default.
evidence.claim: Sandboxing enforces permission-based access control for external tool execution.
